description.value: The Village Estevan is an all-day brunch restaurant steps from Willows Beach in Victoria's Estevan neighbourhood, voted Best Breakfast in the City 2022. Part of The Village franchise, it serves locally inspired brunch dishes alongside directly traded and locally roasted coffee. Cyclists can dine on the patio, order takeout packed for travel, or arrange catering for a group occasion.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 27m; rack at 28m; stands (2 spaces) at 30m; rack at 45m; rack at 76m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at estevanvillage.ca confirms the business as an all-day brunch restaurant at 2518 Estevan Ave, Victoria, matching OSM address and phone number. Takeout is explicitly offered with the phrase 'Take out is available and we pack your brunch intentionally for travel'; a meat-free menu item (Mt Doug Benny) provides positive evidence of vegetarian options. Bike parking, washrooms, and most other cyclist amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website footer copyright reads '© The Village Restaurant - 2020', which is outdated; however, the contact page references a 2022 'Best Breakfast in the City' award, suggesting continued operation.
OSM name 'The Village Estevan Restaurant' differs slightly from website branding 'Estevan - The Village Restaurant'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating brunch restaurant near Willows Beach with confirmed contact details and explicit takeout service; a useful stop for touring cyclists in the Estevan/Oak Bay area of Victoria.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Mt Doug Benny (roasted yams, squash and onion, basil-arugula pesto, hollandaise, parmesan, green onion) — a meat-free dish indicating vegetarian options are available

wow_evidence: Take out is available and we pack your brunch intentionally for travel
